sources.title: SuperCon2 NIMS export
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (per supplied NIMS dataset documentation)
notes: The archive was uploaded by the user and retained unchanged.
The export is automatically extracted from scientific literature using grobid-superconductors and requires paper-level verification.
The supplied data dictionary describes 28 attributes, while this observed CSV export has 23 columns; reconcile versions before relying on absent fields.
The archive includes pressure, measurement method, synthesis-related text, and bibliographic metadata, but extracted values can attach unrelated transitions to a material.
Cite Foppiano et al. (2022), Automatic extraction of materials and properties from superconductors scientific literature, and the NIMS dataset when using this source.
